Implemented the Python port in [xsv_port.py](/C:/Users/liuliu/Documents/tura_workspace/target/project-rebuild-source-port/r-3f9eaf6acf/xsv/codex-main-1/workspace/xsv_port.py), covering the requested behavior areas: `headers`, `count`, `select`, `slice`, `search`, `sort`, `table`, `fmt`, `stats`, and `frequency`.

Packaging is set up with [compile.sh](/C:/Users/liuliu/Documents/tura_workspace/target/project-rebuild-source-port/r-3f9eaf6acf/xsv/codex-main-1/workspace/compile.sh), which creates the runnable entrypoint [executable.cmd](/C:/Users/liuliu/Documents/tura_workspace/target/project-rebuild-source-port/r-3f9eaf6acf/xsv/codex-main-1/workspace/executable.cmd) on Windows and avoids leaving a higher-priority stale `./executable`.

Verified:
- `python ./compile.sh`
- `./executable.cmd --version`
- `python -m py_compile ./xsv_port.py`
- Byte-for-byte differential checks against the official reference CLI for representative stable cases across all implemented commands, including stdin, TSV autodetection, CRLF formatting, selection syntax, slicing, sorting, stats, and frequency non-tie behavior.
